claims.name: Notebook.AntitheticFeedback.field_equations
claims.type:
∀ (eta : Real) (x : Gimle.Asgard.Point 4),
  Eq (Gimle.Asgard.Examples.AIF.field.run (Gimle.Asgard.pointAppend (Matrix.vecCons eta Matrix.vecEmpty) x))
    (Matrix.vecCons (instHSub.hSub (x 2) (x 0))
      (Matrix.vecCons (instHSub.hSub (x 0) (x 1))
        (Matrix.vecCons (instHSub.hSub 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul eta (x 2)) (x 3)))
          (Matrix.vecCons (instHSub.hSub (x 1) (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul eta (x 2)) (x 3))) Matrix.vecEmpty))))

claims.name: Notebook.AntitheticFeedback.realizes_iff
claims.type:
∀ (eta : Real) (state : Gimle.Asgard.Dynamics.Signal 4),
  Iff (Gimle.Asgard.Examples.AIF.Realizes eta state)
    (And (Eq (state 0) 0)
      (∀ (t : Real),
        Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Ici 0) t →
          ∀ (i : Fin 4),
            HasDerivWithinAt (fun s => state s i)
              (Matrix.vecCons (instHSub.hSub (state t 2) (state t 0))
                (Matrix.vecCons (instHSub.hSub (state t 0) (state t 1))
                  (Matrix.vecCons (instHSub.hSub 2 (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul eta (state t 2)) (state t 3)))
                    (Matrix.vecCons
                      (instHSub.hSub (state t 1) (instHMul.hMul (instHMul.hMul eta (state t 2)) (state t 3)))
                      Matrix.vecEmpty)))
                i)
              (Set.Ici 0) t))

claims.name: Notebook.AntitheticFeedback.tube_from_certificates

statement_expansion.text:
∀ {nt nb : Nat} (m : Gimle.Forseti.Examples.AIFMesh.Mesh (instHAdd.hAdd nt 1) nb) (b : Fin nb),
  (∀ (i : Fin (instHAdd.hAdd nt 1)), Rat.instLT.lt 0 (m.slab b i).step) →
    Rat.instLT.lt (m.edges b.castSucc) (m.edges b.succ) →
      ∀ (p : Real),
        Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc (m.edges b.castSucc).cast (m.edges b.succ).cast) p →
          ∀ (state : Real → Fin 4 → Real),
            (∀ (i : Fin (instHAdd.hAdd nt 1)) (t : Real),
                Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc (m.times i.castSucc).cast (m.times i.succ).cast) t →
                  ∀ (j : Fin 4),
                    HasDerivWithinAt (fun z => state z j) (Gimle.Forseti.Examples.AIFDriftModel.field p (state t) j)
                      (Set.Icc (m.times i.castSucc).cast (m.times i.succ).cast) t) →
              ∀
                (certificates :
                  (i : Fin (instHAdd.hAdd nt 1)) → Gimle.Forseti.Examples.AIFSlabDrift.CellCertificates (m.slab b i)),
                Real.instLE.le
                    (Gimle.Forseti.Examples.AIFMesh.tubeEnergy (m.slab b 0) (m.times 0).cast p (state (m.times 0).cast))
                    (1 / 40000) →
                  ∀ (i : Fin (instHAdd.hAdd nt 1)) (t : Real),
                    Set.instMembership.mem (Set.Icc (m.times i.castSucc).cast (m.times i.succ).cast) t →
                      Real.instLE.1 (Gimle.Forseti.Examples.AIFMesh.tubeEnergy (m.slab b i) t p (state t)) (1 / 40000)
